{"reason": "Added a high-confidence gate and raised the exposure floor to 700000. Six of eight false rows have confidence<0.7; the two high-confidence misses (0.83, 0.91) sit at exposure 680k/690k, below the new floor. This cuts false-arbitration-rate from 0.714 while large, confident, unfrozen changes still arbitrate, protecting the 0.8 recall gate.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 700000)
       (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
